dropped_synthetic.statement: ABC44 accelerates ageing in Caenorhabditis elegans under standard culture conditions.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Testing showed no significant effect on lifespan, so ABC44 does not accelerate ageing in this organism.

dropped_synthetic.statement: ABC44 extends lifespan in Caenorhabditis elegans through dietary restriction mediated by the pharynx.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Since ABC44 had no significant effect on lifespan, it cannot extend life via dietary restriction or any other mechanism.

imp001.statement: Promethazine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp002.statement: Procaine HCl shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
imp002.why_false: Procaine HCl has not been shown to shorten lifespan in Drosophila; available studies report no significant effect or only marginal changes, not a life-shortening one.

imp003.statement: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp004.statement: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inhibiting monoamine oxidase and elevating dopamine signaling.
imp004.why_false: Procaine is a local anesthetic acting mainly on sodium channels; it is not a meaningful monoamine oxidase inhibitor in vivo, and this mechanism does not account for lifespan extension in flies.

imp005.statement: Phenelzine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp006.statement: Phenoxybenzamine Hydrochloride extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp007.statement: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate extends lifespan in male Drosophila melanogaster.
imp007.why_false: The reported extension was observed in females; males did not show a significant lifespan benefit.

imp008.statement: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inhibiting NF-κB signaling.
imp008.why_false: Flies lack a canonical NF-κB pathway of the type PDTC targets; the effect is attributed to antioxidant activity, not NF-κB inhibition.

imp009.statement: Carbidopa extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

imp010.statement: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate shortens lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Published work reports lifespan extension, not shortening, with this compound in flies.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Diethyldithiocarbamate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The related dithiocarbamate diethyldithiocarbamate was tested in flies and failed to extend lifespan.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: The compound is documented to increase, not decrease, longevity in this organism.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster larvae.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Lifespan effects were measured in adults; no lifespan extension has been shown at the larval stage.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Disulfiram extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Disulfiram, another dithiocarbamate-class compound, has not been shown to extend lifespan in flies.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Pyrrolidine dithiocarbamate extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster by inducing the insulin/IGF signaling pathway.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Reduced, not induced, insulin/IGF signaling is associated with lifespan extension in flies; PDTC's effect is consistent with antioxidant protection rather than pathway induction.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Procaine HCl accelerates ageing in Drosophila melanogaster when administered continuously in the culture medium.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Continuous administration of procaine HCl in the medium has not been shown to accelerate ageing in Drosophila; trials found no significant lifespan effect in either direction.

dropped_synthetic.statement: Procaine HCl extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster through enhanced DNA methylation of age-related genes.
dropped_synthetic.why_false: Procaine is occasionally described as a weak DNA methylation inhibitor, not an enhancer, and DNA methylation-based lifespan extension via procaine is not established in Drosophila, which has minimal cytosine methylation.
